full_track.tags: Contemporary K-Pop R&B ballad. The arrangement features a clean electric guitar playing jazz-influenced chords with a slight chorus effect. A sub-bass synth provides low-end weight, while the percussion consists of a crisp electronic snare on the backbeat and a tight kick drum. The male lead vocal is smooth and breathy, utilizing a mix of chest voice and falsetto. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time. Subtle vocal harmonies and ad-libs are layered in the background. The production is polished with moderate reverb on the vocals and a wide stereo image for the guitar.
